description: Source file implementing UDP datagram payload parsing, serialization, and related classes for the quiche project.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramPayload
classes.description: Base class for UDP datagram payloads with parsing and serialization methods.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
classes.description: Represents a UDP packet payload with a fixed context ID and associated data.

classes.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
classes.description: Represents an unknown or unrecognized UDP payload with a specific context ID.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a datagram payload string into appropriate payload object based on context ID.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the payload object into a string buffer.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload::ConnectUdpDatagramUdpPacketPayload
methods.description: Constructor initializing with UDP packet data.

methods.name: GetContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID of the payload.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of the payload (UDP packet or unknown).

methods.name: GetUdpProxyingPayload
methods.description: Returns the UDP proxying payload data.

methods.name: SerializedLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the serialized payload.

methods.name: SerializeTo
methods.description: Serializes the payload into a QuicheDataWriter.

methods.name: ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload::ConnectUdpDatagramUnknownPayload
methods.description: Constructor for unknown payload with context ID and data.
